---
title: "Seven Years of Music_My Listening Journey"
subtitle: "How my music habit changed from 2019 to 2025"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

annual <- read_csv("my_annual_songs_report.csv")
songs <- read_csv("my_top10_songs.csv")
```
## My Listening Habit

```{r}
ggplot(annual, aes(x = annual_song_count,
                   y = listening_hours,
                   color = factor(year))) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = year), vjust = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "More Songs, Less Time?",
    x = "Number of Songs",
    y = "Listening Hours",
    color = "Year"
  )
```
## My Language Preferences

```{r}
ggplot(songs, aes(x = factor(year),
                  fill = language)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Chinese" = "lightpink",
    "English" = "blue",
    "Japanese" = "lightgreen",
    "French" = "yellow",
    "Spanish" = "orange"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "The Languages of My Music",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Language"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## My Top 10 Songs Across Seven Years

```{r}
ggplot(songs, aes(x = rank,
                  y = factor(year),
                  fill = language)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.85, height = 0.85, color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Chinese" = "lightpink",
    "English" = "blue",
    "Japanese" = "lightgreen",
    "French" = "yellow",
    "Spanish" = "orange"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Seven Years",
    subtitle = "The changing languages of my annual Top 10 songs",
    x = "Song Ranking",
    y = "Year",
    fill = "Language",
    caption = "NetEase Cloud Music Annual Reports"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
